name: Horse lowpoly
author: jjmoser
changes: Mesh-only extraction without executing source scripts; 180 degree heading rotation, 0.35 meter scale, ground origin; Studio supplies its own rig and material nodes.

limitations: Low resolution modeling source, not a photoreal production asset. Rigging, animation, fur and final appearance are not authored or approved by the source artist.
